api.signature: official_zsre_metrics(summary, *, config_values, endpoint, edits, pre_state_edits=None, post_state_edits=None)
api.summary: 공통 zsRE reducer의 실측 summary. raw case/token/text는 넘기지 않는다.
api.semantics: E/G는teacher-forced target accuracy/request macro, S는W0 prediction agreement, loc_ans정답정확도별도. Score는E/G/S 조화평균이며 loc_ans와 혼동하지 않음.
api.validation: official schema+dataset=zsre 전용. built-in finite scalar/정확분모/edits/state 축/score 검산. CF/FLUCON 혼용 및0placeholder금지. 기존 official/* backward compatible, dual alias 값충돌거부.
api.view_filters: config.dataset=zsre; 모델별 config.model=llama3 또는 qwen25 또는 gptj. current와all_seen 패널분리.
